allowed_next.label: Completed
allowed_next.note: Order delivered. The customer is told it was delivered, and a cash-on-delivery payment is marked paid.

allowed_next.label: On hold
allowed_next.note: Pauses the order while you wait for payment or stock. Stock stays reserved. Nothing is sent to the customer.

allowed_next.label: Cancelled
allowed_next.note: Stops the order and puts its stock back. The customer is told it was cancelled.

allowed_next.label: Refunded
allowed_next.note: Marks the order as refunded and puts its stock back.

timeline.title: Confirmed
timeline.description: Status updated from shipped to confirmed via order edit

timeline.title: Shipped
timeline.description: Status updated from packed to shipped via order edit

timeline.title: Packed
timeline.description: Status updated from confirmed to packed via order edit

timeline.title: Confirmed
timeline.description: Order confirmed by merchant (COD verification complete).
